posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared her wholesome May photo dump featuring Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan, including birthday celebrations and her ongoing quest for the best hot chocolate.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit shared BTS pics with Neeru Bajwa from Sardaar Ji 3, releasing June 27. His film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Sharvari and Vedang Raina also arrives June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bobby Deol reacted to clash rumors on the Alpha set with Alia. She's gearing up for YRF's spy universe film Alpha and Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War with Ranbir Kapoor.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka shared poolside Sunday photos from Hyderabad where she's filming SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu, marking her big Indian cinema comeback.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's grey-shades look from King reportedly leaked, sending fans into a frenzy. Anirudh is confirmed to compose BGM for the action thriller co-starring daughter Suhana Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena enters her 'padel era' while wrapping Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. She's also in talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's upcoming superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological epic Mahavatar, while also preparing for a period musical drama with director Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy while juggling a packed slate — she's joining SRK's King and Allu Arjun's mega-budget Raaka directed by Atlee.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 is dropping on OTT this week as Ranveer rides the wave of the franchise's ₹1,000 crore global success. He and Deepika were also spotted enjoying a friend's NYC wedding.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya made her 24th Cannes appearance in stunning couture looks. Madhuri Dixit and Kangana Ranaut rallied to her defense against body-shaming trolls online.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is going all out promoting Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon — their playful BTS moments are going viral ahead of the June 19 release.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is reportedly in talks to star opposite Salman Khan in Raj & DK's next directorial, and buzz is also building around a possible Shah Rukh Khan-Rajkumar Hirani collaboration.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun has begun filming Raaka with director Atlee — the ₹600 crore sci-fi spectacle featuring Deepika Padukone, Mrunal Thakur, and Janhvi Kapoor kicked off in Mumbai.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan is on a massive promotional blitz for Peddi, releasing June 4. At the Chennai event, he praised CM Vijay and declared Peddi will be a sure blockbuster after RRR.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR filmed an epic dance face-off with Hrithik Roshan for War 2 at YRF Studios. He's also collaborating with KGF director Prashanth Neel on a massive 2027 release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the sports drama Peddi hitting theaters June 4. She's also part of Allu Arjun's mega-budget Raaka with director Atlee.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's all-white ethnic look went viral, while Triptii Dimri and Madhuri Dixit publicly defended her against online trolling over her Chand Mera Dil dance scene.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stole the spotlight at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary in a stunning pink saree with Sidharth Malhotra. Her role as Nadia in Yash's Toxic continues to build buzz.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik completed his high-energy dance showdown with Jr NTR for War 2, wrapping the film's 18-month production. He's also been approached for a cameo in Jailer 2.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun was spotted dancing with fans at the IPL 2026 final in Ahmedabad while promoting Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, his rom-com with Mrunal Thakur releasing June 5.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: India's melody queen continues her packed concert schedule across the country, while lending her voice to some of the biggest upcoming Bollywood and South Indian film soundtracks.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is composing music and co-producing Shekhar Kapur's Masoom: The New Generation. He's also scoring Ram Charan's Peddi and the highly anticipated Ramayana epic.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Now Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister after a historic election win, Vijay's swan song film Jana Nayagan is targeting a major June theatrical release amid massive anticipation.
